alt.en: Six bilingual answer-case pairs and all nine KA-0 retrieval pairs are frozen before candidate execution. Every attempt retains raw output and separate format and semantic decisions. Two current-amount cases accept 750 with a period semantically despite exact-match failure; the historical case rejects the same answer.
alt.zh-hans: 六组双语回答题和全部九组 KA-0 检索题在候选执行前冻结。每次尝试保留原输出，分别记录格式和语义判断。两道现行金额题接受带句点的 750，虽然它未通过精确匹配；历史题却必须拒绝同一个答案。
